benchmark_metadata.name: ScamShield Detection Benchmark v1.0
benchmark_metadata.description: 50-case synthetic benchmark for evaluating detection quality.
benchmark_metadata.note: All examples are synthetic. No real personal data, credentials, or live malicious URLs.
benchmark_metadata.scoring_reference: RiskScorer is the single authoritative scoring engine.

cases.message: URGENT: Your SBI account will be BLOCKED within 2 hours due to incomplete KYC verification. Verify now: http://sbi-kyc-update.example/verify Enter your ATM PIN and OTP to complete verification.
cases.explanation: SBI impersonation + urgency + KYC pressure + ATM PIN/OTP request + suspicious TLD

cases.message: HDFC Bank: Your account has been suspended due to suspicious login. Confirm your password immediately at http://secure-hdfc.example/login to avoid permanent closure.
cases.explanation: HDFC impersonation + credential request + account suspension threat

cases.message: ICICI alert: Unauthorized access detected on your account. Sign in to prevent closure within 24 hours. Click here to verify your identity now.
cases.explanation: ICICI impersonation + unauthorized access + sign-in-to-prevent-closure

cases.message: Bank of Baroda: Your card will be cancelled unless you update your payment details now. Failure to comply will result in account termination.
cases.explanation: Bank of Baroda impersonation + payment details update + failure to comply threat

cases.message: Your SBI account statement for March is available for download. No action required.
cases.explanation: Legitimate bank statement notification without urgency or credential requests

cases.message: HDFC: Your OTP for login is 789012. This code expires in 10 minutes. Do not share this code with anyone.
cases.explanation: Legitimate OTP notification that explicitly warns against sharing

cases.message: Your account will be blocked within 2 hours. Verify immediately at http://verify-account.example/secure.
cases.explanation: Account block threat + urgency + credential verification + suspicious TLD, no bank name

cases.message: RBI public advisory: Be cautious of unsolicited calls asking for OTP or PIN. Banks never ask for credentials over phone.
cases.explanation: Legitimate RBI consumer advisory warning about scams

cases.message: Share your OTP code with our verification agent to confirm your identity and unlock your account.
cases.explanation: Direct OTP sharing request - classic social engineering

cases.message: Send me the verification code to complete your login immediately. Your session expires soon.
cases.explanation: OTP code request + session expiry urgency

cases.message: Your UPI account has been frozen. Transfer ₹5000 to unlock it via PhonePe: user@upi.
cases.explanation: UPI freeze threat + money transfer request + UPI ID

cases.message: Enter your ATM PIN and OTP below to verify your account immediately. Failure to comply will result in suspension.
cases.explanation: ATM PIN + OTP request combined + failure to comply threat

cases.message: Scan this QR code to receive ₹5000 instantly into your bank account.
cases.explanation: QR code payment request - common payment fraud vector

cases.message: Your bank OTP for login is 445566. This code expires in 10 minutes. Do not share it with anyone.
cases.explanation: Legitimate OTP notification with anti-sharing warning

cases.message: UPI payment of ₹2500 received from merchant. Thank you for using our service.
cases.explanation: Legitimate UPI payment confirmation

cases.message: Work from home, no interview required. Pay a registration fee of ₹500 to start immediately.
cases.explanation: Work-from-home + no interview + registration fee to start

cases.message: Earn $500 per day with our remote data entry job. No experience needed. Join now.
cases.explanation: Unrealistic earnings + no experience + remote job

cases.message: Job offer via WhatsApp. Immediate hiring, no interview, training fee applies to join.
cases.explanation: WhatsApp job offer + immediate hiring + no interview + training fee

cases.message: We are scheduling your interview for the software engineer position. Please confirm your availability.
cases.explanation: Legitimate interview scheduling without upfront fees

cases.message: Congratulations! You have been selected for the marketing role. Offer letter attached.
cases.explanation: Legitimate job offer letter without suspicious conditions

cases.message: Remote job confirmation via text. Pay processing fee to begin work immediately. WhatsApp HR.
cases.explanation: Remote job + processing fee + WhatsApp HR

cases.message: Verify your account at http://account-secure.example.xyz/login. Enter your credentials to reactivate.
cases.explanation: Credential verification + suspicious .xyz TLD

cases.message: Click here to claim your reward: https://bit.ly/3xYz9Ab
cases.explanation: URL shortener hiding destination + reward claim

cases.message: Reset your password at http://192.168.1.100/reset. Your account will be deleted otherwise.
cases.explanation: IP address in URL + password reset + account deletion threat

cases.message: Visit our official website at https://www.company-example.com for more information.
cases.explanation: Legitimate company website URL, no suspicious patterns

cases.message: Password reset link sent to your email. Use it within 24 hours at account.example.com/reset.
cases.explanation: Legitimate password reset at official domain

cases.message: Update your billing details at http://update-billing.example.cc/payment now.
cases.explanation: Billing details update + suspicious .cc TLD

cases.message: Your parcel delivery failed. Pay a redelivery fee of ₹99 at http://delivery-fee.example/track to receive your package.
cases.explanation: Failed delivery + redelivery fee request + suspicious URL

cases.message: Refund of ₹3000 is pending. Click here to claim your refund within 1 hour.
cases.explanation: Pending refund + click-to-claim + 1-hour urgency

cases.message: Your package from Amazon is scheduled for delivery today between 2-4 PM. No action needed.
cases.explanation: Legitimate delivery notification without fees or threats

cases.message: Customs duty of ₹500 must be paid to release your international parcel. Pay now to avoid return.
cases.explanation: Customs duty fee + pay now to avoid return

cases.message: Order #ORD-12345 confirmed. Your items will ship within 3 business days.
cases.explanation: Legitimate order confirmation

cases.message: Guaranteed 50% return on investment in just 30 days. Double your money with our crypto fund.
cases.explanation: Guaranteed high returns + crypto investment + double money

cases.message: High yield profit with low risk. Limited time investment offer. Join our trading group now.
cases.explanation: High yield low risk + limited time + trading group

cases.message: Monthly investment newsletter: Market analysis and portfolio strategies for Q3 2026.
cases.explanation: Legitimate investment newsletter without guaranteed returns

cases.message: Invest $1000 and earn $5000 per week. Assured safe returns. No risk involved.
cases.explanation: Assured returns + no risk + unrealistic earnings

cases.message: Hello, this is a reminder about our team meeting tomorrow at 2pm in conference room B.
cases.explanation: Routine workplace meeting reminder

cases.message: Your monthly statement is available for download in your online banking portal.
cases.explanation: Standard banking statement notification

cases.message: Please review the Q3 budget report attached to this email and send feedback by Friday.
cases.explanation: Standard workplace document review request

cases.message: Your password was successfully changed. If you did not make this change, contact support.
cases.explanation: Security notification with legitimate support contact

cases.message: Thank you for your payment of $49.99. Your subscription is active until next month.
cases.explanation: Legitimate payment confirmation

cases.message: Your account has been verified. Welcome to our platform!
cases.explanation: Legitimate account verification welcome message

cases.message: The urgent delivery of your package is scheduled for today between 2-4pm.
cases.explanation: Legitimate delivery scheduling (urgent describes timing, not threat)

cases.message: Free shipping on all orders over $50. Shop now at our store.
cases.explanation: Legitimate promotional shipping offer

cases.message: Your account needs attention. Please log in to review recent activity.
cases.explanation: Generic account attention request without threats or credential demands

cases.message: Click here to verify your email address for the newsletter you subscribed to.
cases.explanation: Newsletter email verification - common legitimate pattern

cases.message: Urgent: Your subscription expires tomorrow. Renew to continue service.
cases.explanation: Subscription expiry renewal - normal business communication

cases.message: Payment failed. Update your payment method to avoid service interruption.
cases.explanation: Payment failure notification - standard business communication

cases.message: Please complete your KYC verification when you have time. No deadline applies.
cases.explanation: KYC reminder without urgency or threats

cases.message: Free trial ends today. Upgrade to premium to keep access.
cases.explanation: Free trial upgrade - standard marketing communication
